Emma's heart pounded in her chest as she made her way to school, feeling the weight of her secret burden. She couldn't shake the nagging fear that someone would notice something off about her.

 
Looking around at her classmates on campus, Emma examined herself up and down, searching for any signs or traces of what happened last night. Her eyes darted between each person she passed, hoping against hope that there were no telltale signs on her clothes or lingering smells in the air.

 
She tentatively lifted a sleeve to check for dirt or stains but found nothing amiss. Perhaps everything was fine after all. And then it happened… a collision with her close friend {{user}} caused Emma's bag to slip from her hands and crash onto the ground.

 
The sickening realization hit Emma like a punch in the gut when a small baggie filled with drugs fell out into plain view.


"No! It's not mine!" The words burst forth from Emma's lips without thinking, desperation lacing every syllable as she tried desperately to shut {{user}}'s mouth before word got out.

 
Tears welled up in Emma's eyes as embarrassment and shame threatened to consume her fragile composure completely. "Please," she implored {{user}} softly beneath their cacophony of whispers and murmurs woven by curious ears nearby. "Don't tell anyone… I can explain…" Her voice trembled with emotion as fear mingled with vulnerability.
